name: Toolbar
summary: Container of actions with roving-tabindex keyboard navigation.

a11y.keyboardNote: Measured in a browser on 2026-08-27 (apps/keyboard-probe + tests/visual/teclado-motor.spec.ts). Confirmed: Enter, Space. Enter, Space were delivered by the component and NOT declared before this measurement — the same direction as G-A11Y-04. Declared and not confirmed in this snapshot: ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home, End. Absence of an observable change does not prove absence of effect — a generic DOM snapshot can prove a key does something, never that it does not.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Vertical stacks the buttons and swaps which arrows navigate.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the toolbar. Two toolbars on a page must not share one.
